ways.label: Truman Track from the highway down to the lower viewing platform

start.name: Truman Track entrance on SH6
start.quote: Truman Track is signposted off SH6, 3 km north of the Punangairi Visitor Centre in Punakaiki

end.name: Lower viewing platform
end.quote: The walk ends at the lower viewing platform

via.name: Upper viewing platform
via.quote: From the upper platform, enjoy spectacular views

evidence: Truman Track leads from the highway just north of Punakaiki down to the Tasman Sea.
The walk ends at the lower viewing platform.
Return to the carpark the same way you came.

not_on_route.name: Pancake Rocks
not_on_route.quote: and south to the Pancake Rocks

not_on_route.name: Beach at the end of Truman Track
not_on_route.quote: There are serious hazards if you choose to explore the beach

doubts: The car park is across the road from the track entrance; the start is given as where Truman Track meets SH6 (F2). The lower viewing platform end has no entry, so its ref is null. Exploring the beach beyond the platform is optional and not part of the walk.
